observations.body: The LORD contrasts heaven and earth with a human-built house, regards the humble, and compares unchosen sacrifice with murder, broken necks, blood, and idolatry.
observations.label: Chosen offerings can become acts of violence

observations.body: The passage presents divine throne, humble hearer, animal offerings, violent comparisons, chosen ways, and ignored call as the scene's observable response or movement.

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 66:1–4 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the comparison concerns worshipers who choose their own ways and does not redefine every animal offering as violence
